title: Periodontology I: Main Exam, 11 December 2018
programme: Bachelor of Science in Community Oral Health
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A

parts.text: Outline the functions of the periodontium.
Briefly discuss local plaque retentive factors.
Outline the differences between normal and diseased periodontium.
Briefly describe the formation and composition of dental plaque.
Enumerate factors influencing the distribution of periodontal disease.

items.text: In details discuss the role of systemic diseases in the etiology of periodontal disease.
Discuss clinical presentation, diagnosis, treatment planning and management of chronic periodontitis.
Discuss methods that can be used to give Oral Education on periodontal disease.
